results.title: China Threatens to Cancel Xi-Trump Summit Over Taiwan Arms Deal
results.description: China has warned it will cancel the September 24 Trump-Xi summit at the White House if Washington approves a $14 billion arms package for Taiwan, forcing Trump to choose between his prized pre-midterm diplomatic win and America's commitment to Taiwan's defense.
